name: Feral Boar
behaviour: Roots in leaf litter at dawn and dusk; sows travel with piglets; raids crab burrows and turtle nests.

rules: Charges if cornered within 4 m
Sow with piglets charges at 10 m
Flees when HP < 30%
Night: more active, roams near camp food

tameable: piglet only (Camp Lv4 pen, trust 3 feedings)
pet_synergy: Tide-Puck 'track' finds wallows; 'guard' warns of a charge 2 s early.
source: Feral pigs introduced by sailors prey on crab juveniles and nests (SPREP).

name: Wild Goat
behaviour: Grazes cliff ledges in small herds; flees uphill; kids follow nannies.

rules: Flees at 15 m
Billy butts if trapped (8 dmg)
Herd alarm spooks all goats in 30 m

source: Selkirk ran down feral goats and tamed kids for milk (RMG).

name: Coconut Crab
behaviour: Nocturnal; hides in burrows by day; climbs palms; steals shiny items from camp.

rules: Pinches if grabbed or stepped near burrow
Steals 1 scrap/gold from unguarded camp at night (10%)
Day: dormant in burrow

pet_synergy: 'dig' exposes burrows; Tide-Puck guard stops night theft.
source: Coconut crab claws reach ~3,300 N; nocturnal burrowers (Current Biology).

name: Land Crab Swarm
behaviour: Mass migration to the sea to spawn after first heavy rains.

rules: Swarm blocks paths; easy gathering for 1 game day

source: Land crabs migrate en masse to spawn.

name: Sea Krait / Tree Boa
behaviour: Kraits come ashore at night among rocks; boas drape over trails.

rules: Krait bites only if handled or trodden on (venom: -2 HP/s for 10 s)
Boa constricts if you walk under it at night

pet_synergy: 'scout' marks snakes on trails; herbs cure venom.
source: Sea kraits are venomous but placid and come ashore at night.

name: Macaque Troop
behaviour: Troops of 5-12 raid camps for food and shiny tools; alarm calls on predators.

rules: Steals food/tools if stores unguarded
Mobs if a juvenile is grabbed
Alarm calls reveal hidden enemies within 25 m

source: Macaques raid camps and give alarm calls.

name: Gull / Frigatebird
behaviour: Flocks over fish schools; frigatebirds rob catches; colonies nest on cliffs.

rules: Steals drying fish (15%)
Colony mobs intruders near eggs

tameable: injured chick (spotter: reveals fish schools at sea)
pet_synergy: Wheeling gulls mark fish; Tide-Puck 'fish' doubles yield under them.
source: Tromelin castaways lived on sooty tern colonies (INRAP).

name: Green Sea Turtle
behaviour: Females nest on beaches at night; slow ashore, fast in water.

rules: Flees to sea; can be flipped on its back on land
Overhunting a beach stops nesting for 7 days

source: Serrano flipped turtles, drank their blood, used shells as rain catchers.

name: Reef / Tiger Shark
behaviour: Reef sharks patrol drop-offs; tiger sharks hunt shallows at dusk; drawn by blood and thrashing.

rules: Aggro if player bleeding or carrying speared catch
Dusk/night: tiger shark enters shallows
Retreats after a nose strike (stun)

pet_synergy: Tide-Puck 'scout' warns of fins; 'lure' (lv8) draws it away.
source: Sharks are drawn by blood and thrashing in shallows (NOAA reef hazards).

name: Stingray

rules: Strikes if stepped on (avoid with shuffle walk)
Barb wound: -15 HP and bleeding

source: Stingray barb wounds when stepped on; shuffle feet.

name: Moray Eel
behaviour: Lives in crevices; bites hands reaching into holes.

rules: Bites when player gathers from a crevice node (20%)
Never leaves its hole

pet_synergy: 'scout' checks crevices first; eating moray risks ciguatera.
source: Moray bites are ragged and bleed (NOAA); morays carry ciguatera.

name: Stonefish

rules: Sting on step: -25 HP, slowed 30 s; hot water at a fire halves it

source: Stonefish stings cause intense, prolonged pain (NOAA).

name: Ship Rat
behaviour: Came ashore from wrecks; eat stores and gnaw sleepers at night.

rules: Eats 1 food/night from unprotected stores
Bites sleeping player (-2 HP, morale -2)

pet_synergy: Tide-Puck 'guard' or a tamed cat halves losses.
source: Rats gnawed Selkirk's feet; he tamed cats to keep them off (RMG).

name: Feral Ship Cat
behaviour: Wary hunter of rats and birds.

rules: Flees; approaches after being fed fish 3 times

source: Selkirk tamed feral cats; Ada Blackjack's cat Vic kept her company.

name: Mosquito Swarm

rules: Dusk exposure without a smoke fire: 5% fever chance per night

pet_synergy: None; smoke fires and herbs counter it.
source: Fever killed most of the Susanna's crew at St Mary's (Sailing the Black Flag).

name: Wild Mythos
behaviour: Varied creatures tied to Tideborn sites; crystal-maddened near UTC sites.

rules: Calm near Tideborn arches
Hostile within 40 m of a dark-binding crystal
Wounded ones can be befriended

tameable: yes - Free & Feed or Weaken & Capture (Blueprint)
pet_synergy: Tide-Puck calms wild Mythos at trust 7+.
source: Blueprint: dark-binding crystals enrage Mythos and the leviathan.
